study.name: paper_2_case_study_15_09_2026
study.title: Focused fixed-energy comparison of the physical consequences of competing control classes
study.question: At fixed Re, AR and fixed actuation-energy budget E=0.25, how does the modal organization (uniform / stationary 2nd harmonic B1 / mixed B3 / temporal B2) reorganize circulation, strain-rate, wall shear and dissipation?

pinn_mean.method: Moyenne temporelle puis moyenne sur les 15 seeds de la campagne Paper2 au point (500,0.25)
pinn_mean.normalization: U_mean_normalise par son max (O(1)) comme la serie LBM existante (convention U_ref x U_lid_norm)

lbm.diagnostics_convention: champs normalises par U_ref ; nu = 1/Re (non-dimensionnel) ; Phi = nu*(2*S11^2 + 2*S22^2 + 4*S12^2) avec S11=du/dx, S22=dv/dy, S12=0.5*(du/dy+dv/dx), equivalent a (2/Re)[ux^2 + vy^2 + 0.5*(uy+vx)^2] = 2*nu*S:S (standard manuscrit). eps_xx=2nu∫ux², eps_yy=2nu∫vy², eps_xy=nu∫(uy+vx)²
